units.source_text: 柏木尤其痛苦，心情一天比一天恶劣，没精打采地度日。

en.t: Kashiwagi was especially tormented; his spirits worsened day by day, and he passed his days listlessly.

units.source_text: 贺茂祭那天，诸公子争先恐后，前往观礼。

en.t: On the day of the Kamo Festival, the young noblemen vied with one another to go and watch the ceremonies.

units.source_text: 他们都来约柏木同行，但柏木心绪不佳，一概拒绝，

en.t: They all came to invite Kashiwagi to go with them, but he was in no mood and refused them all,
and simply lay there with a sorrowful frown.

units.source_text: 他对自己的妻子二公主态度毕恭毕敬，

en.t: Toward his wife, the Second Princess, he behaved with the utmost formality and respect,

units.source_text: 几乎从来不曾开怀畅叙，常常独宿在自己室中。

en.t: almost never speaking with her openly, and he often slept alone in his own room.

units.source_text: 此时他正百无聊赖地独坐凝思，

en.t: At this moment he was sitting alone in weary boredom, sunk in thought,

units.source_text: 忽见一个女童拿了一枝贺茂祭时插头的葵草走进来，便独吟道：

en.t: when he suddenly saw a young serving girl come in carrying a sprig of aoi to be worn in the hair for the Kamo Festival, and he chanted softly to himself:
